name: Team Bootstrap
announce: Turns "I want a project that does X and I need a team" into a working team. /team-bootstrap:team-bootstrap interviews the operator, then stands the whole team up with ONE [agent:team create] carrying the brief — Clodex mints the team, creates or adopts the root, and spawns and briefs the lead itself. When the operator has only a rough idea it sends mode:interview instead, and the lead interviews them before filing anything. Content only — no engine, no renderer, no intent verb. Needs the privileged team-create intent on the interviewing seat.
